method: official-style 8-case correctness + command bench (8 shapes, 3 bench rounds, median, bootstrap 95% CI)

unusable_scaffold_ops.grouped_matmul: Python wrapper only; no C++ op or registration, cannot build a benchmark
unusable_scaffold_ops.moe_re_routing: vendor kernel fails to compile on CANN 9.1 (Adds static_assert for __bf16 / signed char)

harness_fixes: run_cannbench: read metrics before the exit-code check; failed bench cases become fail_correctness with shape/dtype (PR #11)
bench_nonce.py: persist and re-emit the metrics payload even when the bench script exits non-zero; only a run without metrics is an error
test/bench scripts: import torch_npu explicitly; torch.device('npu') otherwise raises ModuleNotFoundError before the op runs
moe bench reference: build the expected row_idx on CPU (NPU arange(int32) returned garbage for some sizes) and synchronize the reference before launching the side-stream op
corrections: The earlier note that the vendor moe kernel is wrong on 2/8 bench cases was a bug in our own bench reference; vendor is 8/8.
limitations: single model (deepseek-chat), one run per task, shared machine
official correctness cases use small shapes; the 8 large bench shapes are checked by the bench's own correctness flags
single-session measurement, not a performance commitment for 910B
